data.one_liner: Pluggable, mockable file system abstraction for Dart with in-memory support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a generic file system abstraction mimicking `dart:io`. It allows you to use different implementations such as local disk access, in-memory file systems, or custom file systems interchangeably.
use_when: You need to write unit tests that interact with the file system without touching the actual disk.
You want to build custom file system wrappers or chroot file systems in Dart.
avoid_when: You only need high-level file picking utilities, which are better served by a file picker plugin.
strengths: Comes with a ready-to-use in-memory file system implementation.
Allows using multiple file systems simultaneously as first-class objects.
weaknesses: Does not include platform file picker UI out of the box.
